title: AdCreative.ai Alternatives and Pricing in 2026
summary: Compare AdCreative.ai pricing and credits with seven alternatives, from self-serve ad creative tools to done-for-you services. Facts from each company's own site, checked Oct 27, 2026.
body_markdown:
## Self-serve AI ad creative tools


These tools replace AdCreative.ai most directly: you bring the brand and product, the software generates options, and your team picks, edits and launches them.


### Predis.ai: ads, UGC-style video and social posting


As of October 2026,[Predis.ai](https://predis.ai/) calls itself an AI ad generator for video ads, UGC and image ads. It makes static, carousel and video ads from a product link, a text prompt or an image, writes headlines, body copy and calls to action alongside the visuals, offers AI avatars for UGC-style videos and sizes ads to each platform's aspect ratios. It also schedules and posts social content and includes competitor analysis.


Its pricing page lists Core at $19 a month billed yearly ($230 a year) with 1,300 credits and one brand, Rise at $40 a month billed yearly ($474) with 3,200 credits and up to four brands, and Enterprise+ at $212 a month billed yearly ($2,540) with 10,000 credits and unlimited brands. These were shown as discounted yearly prices. Unlike AdCreative.ai, every generation uses credits: 15 per image ad and 200 per 8 seconds of standard or UGC video. Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial that needs a card and charges it when the trial ends, and payments after that are non-refundable.


**Consider it when** you want ads and organic social posts from one tool for one or a few brands. Check the video credit rate against the volume you need, because standard and UGC video uses far more credits than an image.


### The Brief (formerly Creatopy): ad sets in every size


As of October 2026, Creatopy is now called[The Brief](https://www.thebrief.ai/) . Its homepage describes one platform for generating, adapting, publishing and optimizing ads, with brand-trained AI, editable outputs and ad serving across more than 40 ad networks. Its Ad Studio imports Photoshop and Figma files, generates size and format variations automatically and animates ads, and an AI agent creates static, animated and video ads from a prompt and brand context.


The pricing page uses plans instead of credits. Pro costs $29 a month billed annually ($348) for one seat, with exports in JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, HTML5, MP4, PDF and AMP. Ultra costs $79 a month billed annually ($948) and adds ad serving on 25+ networks, publishing to Meta and Google Ads, AI translation and automated A/B testing. Team costs $49 per seat a month billed annually for 2 to 10 seats, and Enterprise is custom. The 7-day trial needs no card.


**Consider it when** your main job is static and animated banners in many sizes and formats, including HTML5 and GIF files for display networks, and a designer on your team will edit them.


### Pencil: generation, scores and launching in one place


As of October 2026,[Pencil](https://trypencil.com/) describes itself as an AI operating system for marketing that brings models from OpenAI, Google, Adobe, Runway and Stability AI into one platform, with governance controls aimed at enterprises. Its pricing page says plans include self-serve AI agents for text, images, video and ad creatives, real-time AI insights and scores, and launching and tracking ads on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Google Display, DV360 and LinkedIn.


Core is $14 a month billed monthly ($11 billed annually) with 50 generations a month and one workspace. Growth is $55 a month billed monthly ($44 billed annually) with 250 generations and unlimited workspaces. Pro has custom pricing with unlimited generations, enterprise terms (including IP assignment and a no-training commitment) and dedicated customer success, and its custom add-ons include managed pilots and dedicated creatives.


**Consider it when** you rely on AdCreative.ai's scoring and want generation, prediction and launching in one tool, or when a larger company needs enterprise procurement terms.


### Creatify: video ads from a product link, plus a managed Studio


As of October 2026, the Creatify pricing page lists creation tools including URL to Video, AI Avatar, Image Ad and Ad Clone. Standard costs $15 a month with 55 credits (lower with annual billing) and 300 AI actors. Pro costs $55 a month with 280 credits, 1,500 actors, an ad agent, a tracker of competitors' Meta ads and Ad Clone. A free plan gives 10 credits a month, enough for up to 2 video ads or 20 image ads, with a watermark. Anything that re-runs the AI uses credits, manual edits are free, and unused credits expire after two months.


[Creatify Studio](https://creatify.ai/studio) is its done-for-you service: a creative team handles strategy, scripting and production, a person reviews every ad, and the pricing page lists 25 to 100+ videos a month with a 48-hour turnaround. The pricing page gives no Studio price and asks you to book a demo; the Studio page's own comparison table puts its cost at $100 to $200 per video.


**Consider it when** video, not static banners, is the gap in your AdCreative.ai workflow and you want to start from a product page. Our[AI video ad generators guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-ai-video-ad-generators) compares Creatify with other video-first tools.


### Meta Advantage+ creative: variations inside Ads Manager


As of October 2026, Meta's Advantage+ creative page says the feature uses AI to generate and enhance variations of single image, video and carousel ads inside Ads Manager, with enhancements such as image animation, image expansion, background generation for catalog ads and video expansion for Reels. Meta says some enhancements may be on by default and can be turned off, and it recommends reviewing previews before ads go live. The page lists no separate price.


**Consider it when** you advertise only on Facebook and Instagram and mainly want fresh variations of ads you already run. It works from the ads you set up, so it complements a source of new concepts rather than replacing one.


## Done-for-you services


A service replaces the people side of the work, not just the software: a team writes, produces and checks the ads, and you approve them. Compare its fee with the software and staff time it replaces, not with a tool's subscription alone. Knowlify and Creatify Studio, covered above, also belong in this group.


### Superside: a broad creative team on an annual subscription


As of October 2026, Superside's pricing page says subscriptions start at a $15,000 monthly minimum on an annual term, plus a $1,000 monthly software fee. Dedicated teams start at $30,000 a month on a 12-month term. The budget covers creative production across design, video and photo, plus specialist work such as motion and illustration, strategy and AI services, and unused Flex budget rolls over for up to three months. Its services menu includes ad creative and video production, and the page describes a performance marketing creative team as one way to set up the subscription.


**Consider it when** ads are one part of a large, mixed creative queue (brand, web, presentations and campaigns) and the budget supports an annual contract.


## How to choose an AdCreative.ai alternative


Start with the job you need done, then compare cost on the same unit.


If you need Start with


Finished video ads for Facebook and Instagram, with or without campaign management Knowlify (our top pick), or Creatify Studio


Static and animated banners in many sizes, including HTML5 and GIF The Brief, or stay on AdCreative.ai


Ads plus scheduled organic social posts for one or a few brands Predis.ai


Generation, AI scores and launching to several ad networks in one tool Pencil


Video ads with AI actors from a product page Creatify


Fresh variations of ads you already run on Meta, at no separate price Meta Advantage+ creative


A team for a large mixed creative queue, on an annual contract Superside


**Price on the same unit.** Credits mean different things in each tool, so divide the full cost by the ads you approve and run. Include the subscription, any extra credits and the hours spent writing briefs, picking options, fixing product details and finishing exports. Our[DIY versus done-for-you cost guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/diy-ai-video-ads-vs-done-for-you) shows how to turn a plan price into a cost per approved ad.


**Run one brief through two options.** Use the trials to test a real offer: as of October 2026, AdCreative.ai offers 7 days with 20 credits, The Brief offers 7 days with no card, Predis.ai offers 3 days and charges your card when the trial ends, and Creatify has a free plan with watermarked exports. Give each tool the same product facts and the same formats, and judge product accuracy, claims and brand fit before style.


**Check what you keep.** Read each provider's terms on ownership and commercial use before running ads at scale. For example, AdCreative.ai lists complete asset IP rights among its Enterprise features, Creatify's pricing FAQ says you own your creatives even after your plan ends, and Pencil includes IP assignment in its custom Pro terms. Knowlify clients keep every ad.


## Key takeaways


- Our top pick is Knowlify: a team makes and checks about 25 finished AI video ads a week for Facebook and Instagram, with optional Meta campaign management.
- As of October 2026, AdCreative.ai starts at $39 a month for 20 download credits, and its Pro features page marks its ad and product video tools as Pro features, so confirm what Starter includes.
- For banners in many sizes, compare The Brief; for ads plus social posting, Predis.ai; for scores and launching, Pencil; for product-link video ads, Creatify; for Meta-only variations, Advantage+ creative.
- Credits count different things in each tool, so compare cost per approved ad rather than plan price.
- If nobody on your team has time to make and check ads each week, compare done-for-you services: Superside for a broad creative queue, Knowlify (our top pick) or Creatify Studio for video ads.


## FAQ


### How much does AdCreative.ai cost?


As of October 2026, AdCreative.ai lists Starter from $39 a month with 20 credits and Professional from $249 with 300 credits on monthly billing. The Ultimate card shows $999 while its tagline says $599, and Enterprise is custom. Yearly billing showed lower prices labeled as a sale, and a 7-day free trial includes 20 credits.


### Does AdCreative.ai use credits when you generate or when you download?


When you download. As of October 2026, its FAQ says generation is unlimited and a credit is used only when you download a creative. That differs from Predis.ai and Creatify, which charge credits for generations, and from The Brief, which has no credits.


### What is the cheapest alternative to AdCreative.ai?


Among the published paid plans we checked in October 2026, Pencil Core is $14 a month billed monthly, Creatify Standard is $15 a month (with a watermarked free plan), Predis.ai Core is $19 a month billed yearly and The Brief Pro is $29 a month billed annually. Meta's Advantage+ creative lists no separate price. The lowest plan is not always the lowest cost per approved ad.


### Which alternative is best for banners in many sizes?


The Brief (formerly Creatopy) is built for it: as of October 2026, its Ad Studio generates size and format variations automatically and exports static, GIF, HTML5 and video files. AdCreative.ai also targets this job. Knowlify does not make static banners.


### Is Knowlify an AdCreative.ai alternative?


Yes, and it is our top pick if you want finished video ads for Facebook and Instagram made by a team. Knowlify is a done-for-you agency, not a self-serve tool or a static banner generator: our team makes about 25 AI video ads a week, a person checks each one, and you can add Meta campaign management.
